tools.name: colab_dashboard
tools.title: Open Colab Pilot dashboard
tools.description: Open the interactive Colab Pilot dashboard showing Compute Unit balance, burn rate, monthly budget guardrail, active sessions, detached jobs, and alarm controls.

tools.name: colab_allocate_cascade
tools.title: Allocate GPU cascade
tools.description: Try GPU tiers in priority order, verify BF16 support, probe VRAM, system RAM, and NVENC availability, and return safe DataLoader and crop sizing.

tools.name: colab_mount_rclone
tools.title: Mount Google Drive with rclone
tools.description: Configure rclone and mount Google Drive headlessly on a Colab VM with workload-tuned VFS flags and optional secret forwarding.

tools.name: colab_smart_transfer
tools.title: Transfer files safely
tools.description: Transfer files between your workstation and Colab without Jupyter API 500 errors using direct upload for small files and Drive staging or chunking for large archives.

tools.name: colab_launch_detached
tools.title: Launch detached job
tools.description: Launch a Python script detached with nohup on a Colab VM with carriage-return log normalization and 10-second GPU heartbeat status.

tools.name: colab_poll_job
tools.title: Poll detached job
tools.description: Poll a detached Colab job over the REST Contents API to read status JSON and log tails without holding a WebSocket open.

tools.name: colab_reset_vram
tools.title: Reset zombie VRAM
tools.description: Clear sys.last_traceback, IPython Out caches, optional globals, and torch.cuda.empty_cache to reclaim VRAM after a failed cell.

tools.name: colab_keep_warm
tools.title: Register keep-warm lease
tools.description: Register or clear a timed keep-warm lease for a Colab session so the Stop guardrail allows ending a turn intentionally.

tools.name: colab_stop_all
tools.title: Stop Colab sessions
tools.description: Stop one named Colab session or all active sessions, clear leases, and return verified Compute Unit usage.

tools.name: colab_wakeup_alarm
tools.title: Control wakeup alarm
tools.description: Start, stop, inspect, or test the escalating macOS text-to-speech and chirp wakeup alarm.
